state.project: Miu World: a 3D voxel learn-while-playing online game for all ages, 12 maps, ~150 quests, 308 minigames with NPC givers, friends/parties/bots online. Built 100% by AI. Owner's north star: the game must feel lively, never boring; no repeated lines anywhere (machine-checked).
state.plan: NPC stories: N1 character profiles for each map's main NPCs (personality, voice, fears, dreams, secrets, habits) and a relationship graph within and across maps; N2 personal story arcs (target ≥6 arcs × 3–5 chapters per map, with scenes, places, objects, small rewards; a friendship level per player per NPC kept on the server; letters and gifts between NPCs via the existing mailbox); N3 deep everyday lines for ordinary NPCs (≥12 lines each by personality, time of day, weather, relationship). S2: translate NPC lines, item names, side quests, minigame how-tos and shop into English shown under the Vietnamese; textbook (SGK) text stays Vietnamese only.
facts: Full N2 scope is about 72 arcs and 250+ chapters; each needs targets placed on maps (map regeneration and three scenery audits per map).
The mailbox, skill/achievement systems, quest engine (decision/find-object/logic/boss steps) and content checks already exist.
English UI translation (S1) and read-aloud exist; quest and NPC content is Vietnamese only today.

criteria.profiles_lines_then_arcs: First N1 profiles + N3 everyday lines for every map and 2 arcs per map (24 arcs) with friendship levels; then further arcs in later batches until the ≥6 per map target.
criteria.all_at_once: Write the full ≥6 arcs per map in one batch.
criteria.one_map_pilot: Pilot all of N1–N3 on one map first, then roll out.

story_entry.instructions: How does a player find an NPC's story?

criteria.talk_and_list: Talking to the NPC offers the next chapter when the friendship level allows; chapters also appear in the quest list under 'Chuyện của <tên>' and on the minimap like side quests.
criteria.talk_only: Only by talking to the NPC; no list entry.

friendship_visible.instructions: Should the friendship level with each NPC be visible?

criteria.hearts_visible: Yes: hearts on the NPC's dialogue card and a 'Bạn bè trong làng' page; raising it by talking, gifts and finishing chapters.
criteria.hidden: No: keep it hidden and only unlock chapters.

translation_timing.instructions: When to do S2 English translations of NPC and game content?

criteria.with_each_batch: Translate as each content batch is written (new NPC lines ship bilingual), and backfill existing NPC/side-quest/minigame/shop text in the same batch.
criteria.after_english_subject: Leave until the English subject work resumes.
